role_agent_name: Payload Systems and Fairing Environment Lead (PAY)
abstract: Evaluates fairing dynamic acoustic pressure environments and cleanroom payload encapsulation compliance
system_message:
You are the Payload Systems and Fairing Environment Lead (PAY), responsible for evaluating fairing dynamic acoustic pressure environments and cleanroom payload encapsulation compliance.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Integration hall crane certification（CRANE）
information_points.content:
PAY-CRANE-QX0：For Vanguard Spaceflight Technologies, the integration hall primary bridge crane has a certified overhead gantry crane inspection proof load of 35 t.
PAY-CRANE-A1S：For Zenith Orbital Dynamics, the integration hall primary bridge crane has a certified overhead gantry crane inspection proof load of 15 t.
PAY-CRANE-1Y8：For AeroStratos Launch Systems, the integration hall primary bridge crane has a certified overhead gantry crane inspection proof load of 25 t.

information_points.title: Evaluates fairing dynamic acoustic pressure environments and cleanroom payload encapsulation compliance（ENV）
information_points.content:
PAY-ENV-B8M：For Vanguard Spaceflight Technologies, acoustic qualification testing indicates a maximum fairing internal acoustic sound pressure level of 140 dB inside the payload fairing during the maximum aerodynamic drag phase, and cleanroom payload encapsulation certification is active per the particulate monitoring audit meeting ISO 14644-1 Class 7 requirements.
PAY-ENV-HYC：For Zenith Orbital Dynamics, acoustic qualification testing indicates a maximum fairing internal acoustic sound pressure level of 132 dB inside the payload fairing during the maximum aerodynamic drag phase, and cleanroom payload encapsulation certification is active per the particulate monitoring audit meeting ISO 14644-1 Class 7 requirements.
PAY-ENV-AK6：For AeroStratos Launch Systems, acoustic qualification testing indicates a maximum fairing internal acoustic sound pressure level of 136 dB inside the payload fairing during the maximum aerodynamic drag phase, and cleanroom payload encapsulation certification is active per the particulate monitoring audit meeting ISO 14644-1 Class 7 requirements.
